SHELL=/bin/bash
MAILTO=root
# min hour day month dow
01 * * * * root run-parts /etc/cron.hourly
61 4 * * 0 root run-parts /etc/cron.daily
22 25 * * 8 root run-parts /etc/cron.weekly
0 1 * * 1-5 root /usr/local/bin/backup.sh > /dev/null 2>&1
42 4 1 * root run-parts /etc/cron.monthly
*/5 * * * * root /usr/bin/true
30 2 * * * root date +%Y > /var/tmp/ano
